against.head: Weekly: a pullback that is not done
against.text: The pullback from the Jul 13 high is not done: it has not reached the 0.5 retracement and selling volume is rising. A wave 2 usually unfolds in three waves and reaches the 0.618–0.786 of the Apr 21, 2025–Jul 13 advance (−18% to −24%).
